policy.name: Nagaland Trade, Investment and Industrial Policy (NTIIP), 2025 with General Operational Guidelines

schemes.name: NTIIP 2025 State Capital Investment Incentive (SCII)
schemes.notes: SMALL and MEDIUM only (micro not covered by SCII). 30% of P&M cost, max Rs 10 crore. New units or substantial expansion (>=25% addl P&M), registered under NTIIP 2025 portal. TOP-UP ONLY: if UNNATI 2024 CII (50%, Rs 7.5 cr in Nagaland, all districts Zone B) or similar central incentive is received, SCII limited to the difference - in practice UNNATI 50% exceeds 30%, so SCII usually yields nil unless unit is ineligible for UNNATI. Overall cap per unit across all NTIIP incentives Rs 10 crore (para 7.3).

schemes.name: NTIIP 2025 Capital subsidy for women entrepreneurs
schemes.notes: Only units with >=60% ownership by woman/women from the State. 10% of new P&M, max Rs 10 lakh. Same 10%/Rs 10 lakh for differently-abled entrepreneurs (para 6.11 / 8.15).
conditions: At least 60% owned by women from Nagaland

schemes.name: NTIIP 2025 State Capital Interest Subvention Incentive (SCISI)
schemes.notes: 5% for 5 years on loans DISBURSED up to Rs 1 crore principal (P&M), thrust sectors only, notified banks/FIs; computed from commercial production; annual claim within 6 months of FY end. Not for units assisted with state soft loans (6.1.1-6.1.3). Top-up only over UNNATI CIS (5% in Zone B = all Nagaland), so usually nil for UNNATI-registered units.

schemes.name: NTIIP 2025 State GST reimbursement
schemes.notes: 100% of net SGST paid for 5 years from commercial production, new units with GSTIN and minimum investment Rs 50 lakh. Text says 'on the value of investment made in P&M' but states NO percentage ceiling - rate_by_zone left null (cap undefined; assume up to 100% of P&M only if guidelines clarify). Overall NTIIP cap Rs 10 crore per unit; overlap with UNNATI MSLI => only difference claimable (para 7.3).

schemes.name: NTIIP 2025 Assistance for quality certification
schemes.notes: 50% of certification cost (ISO 9001/14001/22000/45001, HACCP, GMP, CE, BIS, AGMARK, FSSAI, organic etc.) max Rs 1 lakh per unit. Policy also states 100% of cost of ZED certification (all three stages) - separate, uncapped in text.

other_benefits: Power tariff subsidy: 25% reimbursement of actual power tariff for 5 years, max Rs 5 lakh per annum, units with installed capacity >=100 kVA/134 HP (para 6.13 / 8.17) - percentage-of-bill, not per-unit.
Soft loans @6% p.a.: tech upgradation (micro Rs 10 lakh, small Rs 50 lakh), new units in thrust areas (micro Rs 20 lakh, small Rs 1 crore), retail/service Rs 10 lakh (paras 6.1.1-6.1.3).
Stamp duty: 50% exemption on loan/mortgage instruments for 5 years (para 6.12).
Power line drawal: reimbursement up to Rs 10 lakh one-time (para 6.7).
100% EOU: 20% capital subsidy up to Rs 1 crore (para 6.9).
Transport: 50% of freight outside State up to Rs 50 lakh/yr for 5 years (para 6.15).
Brand building 50% up to Rs 5 lakh; 100% of IP/GI/patent filing cost (para 6.14); trade fairs 50% up to Rs 50,000/event (para 6.5).

SGST reimbursement ceiling (% of investment) not stated.
Thrust sector list (policy para 4) governs SCISI eligibility; not transcribed.
